add_library(NLS_Miniaudio STATIC miniaudio.c)
target_include_directories(NLS_Miniaudio PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
set_target_properties(NLS_Miniaudio PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON FOLDER ThirdParty)
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(NLS_Miniaudio PUBLIC winmm ole32)
elseif(APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(NLS_Miniaudio PUBLIC "-framework CoreAudio" "-framework AudioToolbox" "-framework CoreFoundation")
else()
    target_link_libraries(NLS_Miniaudio PUBLIC ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} pthread m)
endif()
